question: Does exact current policy grammar contain a broad, inactive, viable and independently identifiable Novaflare reward-selector route, with enough frozen reward and combat opportunity to justify an identity-safe spendthrift-unlock and Novaflare-only telemetry preflight before any new simulator row?
competingOptions: freeze Novaflare as the sole carrier for null-path identity and observation-only telemetry preflight
close the Novaflare reward-selector scalar route and continue only with a materially different source-backed structural discriminator inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

up.text: Deal @4@ damage for every Ember in your lantern.

definition.name: Novaflare
definition.text: Deal @3@ damage for every Ember in your lantern.

up.text: Spill your lantern: gain 4 Ward for each Ember spent. Kindle.

competingUnlockDefinition.name: Emberdance
competingUnlockDefinition.text: Spill your lantern: gain 3 Ward for each Ember spent. Kindle.

candidate.mediator: When played, the existing emberNova effect deals its authored multiplier times the exact pre-play Ember reserve. Dusk Shatter, kills and Kindle can produce Embers; automatic Flare use consumes three and is fixed interference.
candidate.authoredPayoff: Only Novaflare's existing Ember-reserve damage is in scope. Its definition, Ember production, Flare, Emberdance, reward generation, policy and RNG are unchanged in this screen.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: This is the sole uncovered current-main Dusk family: converting a persistent Ember reserve into card damage. It is distinct from closed Ward/Kindle payoff, Shatter output and unconditional resource scalar families.
candidate.claimBoundary: A static reward selector plus current reward and combat opportunities is a deliberately permissive capacity condition. It does not establish an offer, acquisition, draw, play, positive pre-play reserve, damage, causal payoff, package admission or product quality.

selectorFormula.derivation: Current card_score starts with rare weight minus printed cost 2; emberNova aliases to special.doubleBlock; Novaflare has no Dusk aspect bonus and no other base effect.
selectorFormula.scope: This exactly classifies whether a policy would accept Novaflare when it is the highest-scoring normal card reward. It does not classify event or shop acquisition, competing offers or combat play priority.

closedDirections: adding Tithe of Panes or Pyreheart before measured producer bottleneck and decision value
changing Novaflare, Emberdance, Flare, Ember production, reward odds, rarity, price or policy weights
forcing an offer, acquisition, draw, play or positive Ember reserve
reopening Ward, Kindle, Afterimage, Scoreline, Cracked, Shatter, Crown, Honing, cadence or action-economy closures
using shop or event acquisition to rescue a failed reward-selector route without a separate source-backed preregistration
ML, RL, an optimiser, adaptive candidate tuning or protected seeds

novaflarePayoff.current: Exact current emberNova multiplier times pre-play Ember reserve.
novaflarePayoff.status: Fixed observational mechanism; not varied and not a causal estimand.

spendthriftUnlockProfile.baseline: Exact cached unlock profile without spendthrift card unlocks.
spendthriftUnlockProfile.status: Fixed in this zero-row screen. Baseline and enabled levels are preregistered only for the later identity preflight if this screen passes.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.
scorelinePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed throughout; never bundled with Novaflare or Afterimage.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Afterimage payoff and Guarded Strike path.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and Novaflare.

acquisitionPriority.current: Exact frozen policy card score, decline threshold and natural reward/economy path.

designMatrix.kind: single-cell immutable observational reuse; not a factorial
designMatrix.aliasStructure: The reward selector is aliased with the unobserved condition that Novaflare is highest among a normal reward. Current event and shop paths can bypass the decline selector; current path opportunity predates the spendthrift unlock; combat opportunity does not establish a positive Ember reserve. These aliases forbid acquisition or payoff claims and can only authorise exact telemetry.
designMatrix.expansionRule: No simulator or joint cell is authorised. A pass may add only the two identity-preflight knobs below. Any later CRN design must be mechanism-blocked, retain identical policies and seeds in every contrast, and add cross-package joint cells only if shared anchors measure decision-changing interference.

spendthriftUnlockProfile.null: Omitted/baseline exactly reproduces the frozen unlock list, content path, RNG identity, policy identity and results.
spendthriftUnlockProfile.enabled: Adds exactly card:novaflare and card:emberdance through the existing deed unlock path; no content definition, policy, reward algorithm, unrelated pool or RNG call is edited.
spendthriftUnlockProfile.intendedMediator: Only eligibility of the two exact spendthrift cards in matching-tier card pools.

novaflareTelemetry.null: Omitted/off exactly reproduces frozen path, RNG identity, policy identity and results.
novaflareTelemetry.enabled: Observes Novaflare offered source, acquisition, draw, play, pre-play Embers, computed damage and Flare-before-Novaflare ordering without adding an RNG call or changing state.
novaflareTelemetry.intendedMediator: Observation of Novaflare acquisition and Ember-reserve conversion only.

identityPreflightIfAuthorised.proofRule: Each null is proved separately and jointly on the complete frozen cohort before any enabled-profile scientific row. An enabled knob must affect only its named mediator; downstream path differences from the acquisition intervention are outcomes, not identity proof.

capacityDefinitions.rewardSelectorPolicy: The exact frozen Novaflare base card score is at least the policy's exact cardDecline threshold.
capacityDefinitions.selectorInactivePolicy: The exact frozen Novaflare base card score is below cardDecline. This is exact reward-selector inactivity, not proof that event/shop acquisition or combat play is impossible.
capacityDefinitions.robustRewardOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain at least one normal card reward.
capacityDefinitions.robustCombatOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain at least one combat. This only overstates opportunity for a positive Ember reserve.
capacityDefinitions.robustOtherAcquisitionOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen paths visit an event or shop. Reported only to expose selector-bypass alias; it cannot rescue a gate.
capacityDefinitions.potentialActivePolicy: Reward-selector, robust-reward-opportunity and robust-combat-opportunity all hold on the same policy identity.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousSelectorPolicy: Reward-selector holds but one or both robust opportunity conditions fail.
capacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: A potential-active policy has at least one winning frozen row containing both reward and combat opportunity.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Potential-active for the Novaflare reward-selector route but not active for the named shared anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named shared anchor but not potential-active for the Novaflare reward-selector route.

preregisteredMechanisticInteractions: Novaflare payoff x acquisition priority, because acquisition is necessary before reserve conversion
Novaflare payoff x automatic Flare ordering, because Flare consumes the same Ember reservoir
spendthrift unlock profile x Emberdance competition, because the deed adds both cards
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.notEstimatedHere: No interaction is estimated in this zero-row screen. Scoreline and Afterimage anchors are evaluated separately; they are not merged into an old four-factor design.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.crossPackageInterferenceRule: Both shared-anchor separation gates must pass before identity preflight. Later joint cells are forbidden unless comparable enabled-profile telemetry measures interference large enough to change the stop/go decision.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: This stage uses source and cached path evidence only. Telemetry may follow on the same policies and seeds; whole-run causal endpoints require comparable cells with the same baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: After trace and row-label fields are removed, every current row exactly equals its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result before any selector or outcome count is read.

cohort.identity: The exact complete current-main first-look rectangle is reused for selector, opportunity, viability and both shared anchors. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

scoreline.definition: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.

afterimage.definition: At least two of four rows record positive Afterimage Guard damage.

estimands.unit: Frozen policy identity with a two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Exact reward-selector, selector-inactive, potential-active and ambiguous policy counts and identities.
estimands.opportunity: Exact robust normal-reward, combat and other-acquisition path-opportunity policy sets from immutable rows.
estimands.viability: Exact potential-active policies with at least one qualifying winning row.
estimands.separation: Separate exact candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard statistics against Scoreline and Afterimage.
estimands.notEstimated: No Novaflare offer, acquisition, draw, play, pre-play Ember reserve, damage, Flare interference effect, causal payoff, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected seed or product endpoint is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic exact-source score derivation, immutable row identity checks and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One exact carrier, one exact selector formula, one immutable cohort and one complete first look. No threshold, predicate, anchor or cohort changes after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Authorise only identity preflight if every gate passes; close this scalar selector route if any gate fails; record inconclusive if the deterministic decision cannot finish at the cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look support scale. The 0.75 ceiling and one immutable cached fault are unchanged. Scoreline and Afterimage must pass separately.

decisionRules.success: Every selector support, selector inactivity, reward opportunity, combat opportunity, viability, separate two-sided anchor-separation and reliability gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze Novaflare as the sole carrier and implement only the two preregistered identity-preflight knobs. Prove omitted/off path, RNG, policy and result identity separately and jointly on the same 64 policies and four seeds. Do not execute an enabled unlock row, vary a payoff, add a producer, claim acquisition or select a different candidate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the Novaflare reward-selector scalar route. Continue inside issue #421 only if exact current source supplies a materially different non-reward acquisition or combat-policy discriminator with its own preregistration; otherwise close deed-unlocked Ember-reserve damage and proceed to the smallest new deterministic structural primitive. Do not weaken a gate or tune Novaflare.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The current-main source, immutable trace or deterministic screen cannot produce a complete decision before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, a causal factor, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns candidate construction, exact selector evaluation, cache checks, policy classification and stop/go. #524/#525 enter only through already-published immutable #421 decisions and are not reconstructed. No model context, human label, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.
